correctness.rationale: Exact nontrivial Walsh eigenvalue formula from two shell transforms, strict concavity with vertex parameter R in (2,3), root uniqueness and monotonicity at all higher exponents, and Schoenberg/Gram-rank deduction prove all stated n>=4 and p>0 quantifiers. The O(n^-3) expansion follows by uniform Taylor series at p=O(1/n) and derivative n log(3/2)+O(1). Independent direct group sums through n=10 and spectral endpoint checks through n=14 corroborate the proof.

value.rationale: The natural saturated distance min(Hamming,3) has an exact, dimension-dependent all-t Fourier positivity boundary, unlike ordinary Hamming. The analysis exposes a parity-dependent failing Walsh level, an endpoint nullspace of binomial dimension and an exact 1/n decay constant with two parity-dependent second terms, which are structurally useful for positive-definite radial kernel and Hilbert snowflake design; it is a complete infinite-family invariant, not an arbitrary finite slice.
